canada.title: Man to be sentenced for fatal 2025 crash that killed Ontario father of three
canada.summary: A driver in a head-on crash that killed a father of three last year is expected to be sentenced Tuesday in the case that prompted the Ontario government to introduce tougher dangerous driving penalties.

canada.title: Man shot dead during overnight home invasion near Casa Loma: Toronto police
canada.summary: Toronto police are investigating after a man was killed early Wednesday morning in a suspected home invasion.

canada.title: Parks Canada worker in Yukon says trail maintenance already suffering, ahead of job cuts
canada.summary: Ryan Colpitts, a Parks Canada trail worker at Kluane National Park and Reserve in the Yukon, says maintenance in the park is already falling behind – and he fears federal workforce cuts could make it harder to keep visitors to the park safe.

canada.title: Surrey to audit how truck parking, retail cannabis permits awarded
canada.summary: Surrey city council has ordered a trio of new forensic audits into several decisions made by the previous administration — including how it awarded retail cannabis licences and permits to operate truck parking on city-owned land.

canada.title: City of Lethbridge suing for almost $47M over advice on trade and convention centre
canada.summary: The City of Lethbridge has launched a lawsuit of almost $47 million over advice given during the funding and development of a $77-million trade and convention centre completed three years ago.

canada.title: ​Shop owners say people are 'desensitized' to the conditions in Saskatoon's core
canada.summary: Saskatoon business owners say constantly witnessing the fallout of drug use, mental health issues and violence in Saskatoon's core area is taking a toll, and that growing encampments are making it worse.

canada.title: After torturing victim over missing drugs, Saskatoon man played VLTs, stabbed a stranger
canada.summary: Within hours of participating in a brutally violent homicide, Dillon Singler went out and played some VLTs at Market Mall in Saskatoon, where he randomly attacked and stabbed another man.

canada.title: Steinbach software developer uses AI to help people make voting choices, follow local government
canada.summary: A software developer in Steinbach has developed a website that uses AI to comb through online local government sources to help himself, and others, make voting decisions. But some raise concerns about AI's role in the democratic process.

canada.title: Selkirk volunteer hopes federal funds for homelessness make their way to Manitoba city
canada.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney announced $1 billion in funding to tackle homelessness while in Winnipeg earlier this month. Volunteers are hoping a fair chunk of that money will flow to other Manitoba communities.

canada.title: Witnesses, video reveal details of police response that ended with man’s death
canada.summary: Some residents of Murray Avenue in Fredericton are questioning how a response by police to a disturbance complaint ended with a neighbour's home going up in flames and the neighbour dying.

canada.title: 'It's my dream': Sussex parents eager for francophone school to be built
canada.summary: Some parents living in Sussex say a francophone school the province plans to build in the area is highly-anticipated and will help solidify the presence of a growing community of French speakers in the area.

canada.title: She grew up in group homes. Now she’s piecing together her past
canada.summary: Marisa Wright, 37, is trying to piece together her broken childhood through school, police and government records. Some agencies initially supplied only a limited amount of information in a few summary pages and others denied access completely.

canada.title: Couple shocked to find their fixer-upper demolished
canada.summary: A bungalow nestled on the outskirts of Springhill, N.S., was a pandemic purchase for a couple, but they were surprised to return this fall to find all buildings and irreplaceable mementoes on the property gone.

canada.title: Nihtat Gwich'in Council takes municipality, territorial gov't to court over Inuvik community plan
canada.summary: The designated Gwich'in organization based in Inuvik said the Town of Inuvik failed to properly consult and respect treaty rights when developing and approving its community plan.

canada.title: Residents fight to save the last store on Change Islands
canada.summary: With the only grocery store and gas station in Change Islands slated to shut down, some residents in the small central Newfoundland outport community are banding together to create a co-operative and save the community’s lifeline.

canada.title: $65k in donations? That's a lot of bones for a Happy Valley-Goose Bay shelter
canada.summary: The annual holiday fundraising drive for the SPCA in Happy Valley-Goose Bay has started off with a bang following tens of thousands in donations from anonymous animal lovers.

canada.title: Montreal's tax hike is making headlines, but here are other takeaways from the budget
canada.summary: The tax hike is a big deal and represents a broken promise by the mayor during last year’s election campaign. It also may be distracting you from other key elements of this budget. Tax increase aside, here are some takeaways.

rows: Ábrego García's deportation to El Salvador and return to the US became a flashpoint in the debate over President Donald Trump's immigration agenda.
Kilmar Abrego Garcia, the El Salvador native who was mistakenly deported last year, left the U.S. for Spain on Tuesday, the Department of Homeland Security confirmed.
Kilmar Abrego Garcia, who was returned to the U.S. after being mistakenly deported to a Salvadoran mega-prison, is self-deporting to Spain, sources tell ABC News.

WASHINGTON (AP) — Kilmar Abrego Garcia, a Salvadoran national mistakenly deported as part of the Trump administration's immigration crackdown, was leaving the U.S. voluntarily for Spain on Tuesday, according to a person familiar with the matter. ...
He had been ordered to leave the United States by Tuesday, a U.S. official said.
Abrego Garcia was arrested in Baltimore in March 2025 and deported to a Salvadoran prison in what an official later called an “administrative error.”
